question: Can original NVIDIA CFO commentary tables supply a comparable Data Center current-quarter and prior-year revenue pair at conservative Stage1 decision dates without future-vintage backfill?

fixed_extraction.document: Only original SEC EX-99.2 CFO commentary DOCUMENT/TEXT; no news release fallback for numeric row.
fixed_extraction.table: Unique HTML table containing Revenue by Market Platform and a row whose first cell is exactly Datacenter or Data Center (case/whitespace normalized).
fixed_extraction.units: Table must state dollars in millions; current, prior quarter and prior-year row numeric cells are interpreted in USD millions.
fixed_extraction.value: Use first three numeric cells after exact row label, preserving original strings, current/prior-quarter/prior-year and original row/table/source hashes.
fixed_extraction.growth: YoY=current/prior_year-1 from the same original table; verify last displayed YoY percentage within 1.5 percentage points when parseable.
fixed_extraction.missing: No table, nonunique row, unknown unit, invalid numbers or failed check stays unknown; no imputation.
fixed_extraction.time: Parse SEC ACCEPTANCE-DATETIME from original raw submission. First eligible Stage1 signal date is the next actual Qlib trading session after the SEC acceptance calendar date; no same-day use. Historical first issuer press-release clock remains unqualified.
fixed_extraction.definition: Preserve 2020 Mellanox acquisition and any table label/definition changes as flags; do not claim constant economic scope across all quarters.

fixed_checks: 63 raw hashes and selected event identities exact
all source rows including unknown and original acceptance times
annual numeric support, train2011-2022/held2023-2026 Qlib daily known counts, source ages and unknown masks
no SOXX price/label/outcome read, fit, account or fee result
stop: Stop on source/hash/acceptance/calendar mismatch. If comparable numeric support is inadequate or any claimed event fails original table semantics, do not run information fit. Source map alone does not qualify historical first-publication or SOXX alpha.
